facts.fact: ECOWAS says Guinea is one of the implementers of the first series of the World Bank-funded WARDIP, running 2024 to 2028 with the ECOWAS Commission, the African Union and Smart Africa.
ECOWAS says the WARDIP Regional Project Coordination Committee held its inaugural meeting in Conakry on 11 November 2025, with Guinea among the implementing countries.
ECOWAS says The Gambia is one of the implementers of the first series of the World Bank-funded WARDIP, running 2024 to 2028 with the ECOWAS Commission, the African Union and Smart Africa.
ECOWAS says the WARDIP Regional Project Coordination Committee held its inaugural meeting on 11 November 2025, with The Gambia among the implementing countries.
ECOWAS says Guinea-Bissau is one of the implementers of the first series of the World Bank-funded WARDIP, running 2024 to 2028 with the ECOWAS Commission, the African Union and Smart Africa.
ECOWAS says the WARDIP Regional Project Coordination Committee held its inaugural meeting on 11 November 2025, with Guinea-Bissau among the implementing countries.
